story_description: Build the theme editor view and preview panel.
task_description: Users need to create and customize themes with color pickers, glass controls, and font selectors in a visual editor.
atom_description: Users need to create and customize themes with color pickers, glass controls, and font selectors in a visual editor.
problem_statement: Users need to create and customize themes with color pickers, glass controls, and font selectors in a visual editor.
scope_in: Color pickers for all semantic colors; glass level picker; accent color grid; font pickers; save/cancel/delete actions
Implement ThemeEditorView.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: ThemeProfile model exists
SwiftUI ColorPicker is available
System fonts can be enumerated
Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
Existing DesignSystem tokens are available:
`DSColors` - Semantic color tokens (`Blaze/Sources/DesignSystem/Tokens/DSColors.swift`)
`DSGlass` - Glass level and animation tokens (`Blaze/Sources/DesignSystem/Tokens/DSGlass.swift`)
`DSTypography` - Font styles (`Blaze/Sources/DesignSystem/Tokens/DSTypography.swift`)
`DSSpacing` - Spacing scale (`Blaze/Sources/DesignSystem/Tokens/DSSpacing.swift`)
`DSShadows` - Elevation system (`Blaze/Sources/DesignSystem/Tokens/DSShadows.swift`)
`FormSection`, `FormRow` - Form components (`Blaze/Sources/DesignSystem/Components/FormRow.swift`)
`GlassPanel` - Glass panel modifier (`Blaze/Sources/DesignSystem/Components/GlassPanel.swift`)
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
SwiftUI NavigationSplitView is available (macOS 14.0+)
File storage path: `~/Library/Application Support/Blaze/`
Primary font is SF Pro system
Monospace font is SF Mono with Menlo fallback

Mono scale: mono 13 regular, monoSmall 11 regular, monoLarge 15 regular

Built-in themes cannot be edited (only duplicated)

Must support keyboard navigation (accessibility)
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval

functional_requirements: All semantic color pickers (background, surface, accent, text variants, states)
Font family pickers (UI font, mono font)
Save, Cancel, Delete buttons with appropriate states
implementation_steps: Add color picker sections grouped by category
Add action buttons with state management
event_contracts: Event contracts are defined through telemetry events for this atom.
No additional runtime event protocol is introduced.
ui_states: Create mode: Save enabled after name entered
Edit mode: Save enabled after changes
edge_cases: All colors nil - Valid (uses system defaults)
Built-in theme - Edit disabled, must duplicate
failure_modes: Save fails - Show error, keep editor open
If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
